device_label: Microring-assisted MZM I/Q modulator (4 MRMs), two-chip dual-subcarrier super-channel
modulation_format: Nyquist super-channel (two chips, zero guard band), single polarization, back-to-back: QPSK to 220 GBd total (BER below 7% HD-FEC), 16-QAM BER below 20% SD-FEC to 150 GBd and below 24% SD-FEC to 190 GBd; 20 km SMF: 16-QAM 150 GBd and QPSK 220 GBd below 20% SD-FEC; net 612.9 Gb/s per polarization (16-QAM, 190 GBd total, two-chip super-channel)
driver: Keysight M8199B 256 GSa/s DAC with 65 GHz RF amplifiers (about 4 Vpp), 67 GHz GSG probes; SOAs to 15 dBm per modulator; 70 GHz BPDs and 110 GHz real-time scope at the receiver
notes: Authors' earlier ring-assisted MZM I/Q design (ref. 11, same group's arXiv 2509.20584); Q 5300, resonance depth 10.7 dB and 6 dB EO bandwidth 54 GHz are quoted from it, not re-measured here, so they are not entered as cells (6 dB bandwidth reference frequency not stated). Eight MRMs (four per I/Q modulator) on two identical chips combined off-chip. max_baud 110 GBd is per subcarrier per modulator (220 GBd super-channel total over two chips); net 612.9 Gb/s per polarization is the two-chip total, 16-QAM at 190 GBd total (Fig. 2(b)); per-modulator net rate not stated. Drive: single-drive push-pull, amplifier output about 4 Vpp, 2 Vpp per MRM. Footprint 100 um per device; shoreline density 3.06 Tb/s/mm is the authors' figure (not a column). Wavelength not stated; super-channel spectra sit near 1306.5-1308 nm in Fig. 2(c). Platform, fab, doping, Vpi, IL, energy per bit not reported.

device_label: Slow-light 1D PhC silicon MZM, 2 x 500 um, O-band, 300 mm wafer-level
il_onchip_excludes: Grating couplers (input and output); wafer median over dies
substrate: 300 mm high-resistance SOI wafer, 220 nm Si, 2 um BOX
epitaxy_or_stack: 1D photonic-crystal (Bragg grating) waveguide, lattice constant 245 nm, W1 = 0.8 Lambda, W2 = 0.7 Lambda, W3 = 0.5 Lambda; lateral p-n junctions in both arms, P 3.8e17 and N 7.1e17 cm^-3, intermediate region 400 nm from the junction at 2.8e18 cm^-3, P++/N++ 1.9e20 cm^-3; two junctions in series; thermal phase shifter on one arm
modulation_format: NRZ eyes at 56 and 112 GBd; PAM-4 eyes at 112 GBd (TDECQ 1.05 dB) and 150 GBd (TDECQ 1.8 dB); PAM-8 eye at 135 GBd; eyes only, no BER
driver: Keysight M8199B 256 GSa/s AWG (2.7 Vpp) on a GSSG probe, no driver amplifier stated; PDFA, Keysight N1000A oscilloscope; 4th-order Bessel filter and FFE at the receiver, no neural-network equalizer
notes: Median values over wafer-level dies (Fig. 2(b), 2(e)); individual dies about 89.8-100.1 GHz and 1.46-3.71 dB IL. Two active 500 um PhC waveguides (one per arm), two p-n junctions in series (push-pull) on a GSSG differential electrode; footprint 500 um. Lambda 245 nm, W1/W2/W3 = 0.8/0.7/0.5 Lambda, ng 16.3 at 228 THz; doping P 3.8e17, N 7.1e17, intermediate 2.8e18 (400 nm from junction), P++/N++ 1.9e20 cm^-3. Vpi*L 0.66 V cm is stated as following from the static spectra (Fig. 2(a): 0 V and 6 V traces, shift 0.92 nm, FSR 4.04 nm); bias and Vpi convention not stated, so Vpi is empty. Static IL 2.9 dB (one device, Fig. 2(a)) has no stated exclusion. ER 4.3 dB at 56 GBd NRZ, 3.2 dB at 112 GBd NRZ. Eyes only, no BER: 112 GBd PAM-4 TDECQ 1.05 dB (5 taps), 150 GBd PAM-4 TDECQ 1.8 dB (18 taps); 135 GBd PAM-8 label reads 405 Gb/s in Fig. 3(f), text says 400 Gb/s. EO response normalized at low frequency; reference not stated. Electrode metal, gap and length-resolved Vpi not reported.

il_onchip_includes: Ring at the stated detuning point, relative to the off-resonance transmission maximum
il_onchip_excludes: Fiber-to-chip coupling (6 dB per facet) and off-resonance bus loss (normalized away)
epitaxy_or_stack: Euler-bend microring, effective bend radius 3.6 um, variable waveguide width 400 to 800 nm, two-level lateral p-n doping (levels not stated), P++/N++ contacts; 220 nm SOI, 130 nm rib on 90 nm slab
modulation_format: NRZ 100 Gb/s (SNR 5.08) and 140 Gb/s (SNR 4.07); PAM4 224 Gb/s (TDECQ 4.09 dB) and 256 Gb/s (TDECQ 4.18 dB, SD-FEC threshold 1.8e-2, 64-tap FFE); eyes at -3 V bias, -9 dB IL
driver: Arbitrary waveform generator (256 GSa/s, 67 GHz after calibration) with 60 GHz RF amplifier (2 Vpp), 65 GHz bias tee and DC source on a GSG probe; 400 pH spiral inductor between signal pad and N++ metal; PDFA and 100 GHz DCA at the receiver
notes: Headline device. Fig. 2(d): inductor lifts the -9 dB IL response from 40 GHz to full 67 GHz range (over 27 GHz improvement); no 3 dB crossing up to 67 GHz (VNA limit), so bandwidth is a bound. Inductor response peaks about +4 dB near 55 GHz (Fig. 2(d), approx.). FSR 17.1 nm and loaded Q 2000 are from the Fig. 1(e) transmission of the ring (inductor status not stated); on this row only. Euler bend simulated bending loss 21 dB/cm versus 44 dB/cm for an equal-length circular bend (FDTD, not entered). Eye ER 1.9 dB at 100 Gb/s and 1.5 dB at 140 Gb/s NRZ. Baud of the 256 Gb/s PAM4 point is not stated. On-chip power 0 dBm, 6 dB coupling per facet. EO response normalized at low frequency; reference not stated. Wavelength, circumference, doping, Vpi not reported.

device_label: TFLN TWE-MZM (7.5 mm, I channel of I/Q chip) with codesigned SiGe differential driver IC
modulation_format: PAM-4 at 120-180 GBd and PAM-8 at 120-160 GBd, NGMI vs symbol rate; PAM-8 140 GBd error-free under SC-LDPC (5/6) plus BCH (0.9915) FEC; PAM-4 180 GBd NGMI above threshold 0.8714
driver: Dual-channel linear differential SiGe BiCMOS driver IC (130 nm, fT 350 GHz, fmax 450 GHz; 20 dB gain, 605 mW per channel), wire-bonded to the modulator; 256 GSa/s DAC through a GSSG probe; digital pre-emphasis
notes: Only the I channel of the I/Q chip is characterized. Vpi 3.26 V is the modulator's own measurement, taken stand-alone in GSG fashion (implied; drive not stated explicitly), so entered as push-pull MZM Vpi; it was not measured under the differential driver. Authors' Vpi*L 1.1 V cm is referenced to the single-ended signal under differential push-pull drive; it is not reproducible from 3.26 V and 7.5 mm (2.45 V cm; 1.22 V cm if halved), so not entered, and the view derives 2.45 V cm. Stand-alone EO response (Fig. 1(b)) measured to 67 GHz (equipment limit), no 3 dB crossing; S21 normalized to its peak near 5 GHz, noise dips reach about -3 dB near 60 GHz (Fig. 1(b), approx.); EM simulation dashed in the same plot not used. Assembly (driver plus MZM, Fig. 1(d)): 3 dB bandwidth about 60 GHz at mid-gain, wire-bond penalty; terminations 35 ohm instead of 50 ohm. 50 ohm TWE impedance is a design statement (z0_ohm empty). Driver swing 2.8 V per output pair is simulated, not entered. Net 347 Gb/s is 140 GBd PAM-8 under the SC-LDPC plus BCH FEC (rate 0.8262, NGMI threshold 0.8714); 1.4 pJ/bit is the assembly energy on the gross rate, equal to driver IC power (605 mW per channel / 420 Gb/s). PAM-4 at 180 GBd NGMI about 0.95 (Fig. 2(b)), above threshold. Coupling loss above 15 dB (estimated), so 23 dBm into the assembly. Electrode gap, metal, rib geometry, IL not reported.
